note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #18, Q1 2024 Public Safety Perception) keeps the 59 INEGI columns bp1_1..bp1_9_6 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0324.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's data dictionary labels every BP1_* column (e.g. BP1_2_08 'Percepcion de seguridad en el cajero automatico localizado en la via publica'; BP1_4_7 'Incivilidades...: Robo o venta ilegal de gasolina o diesel (huachicol)'; BP1_6_12 'Principales formas de enterarse...: No lo hace'; BP1_9_5 'Percepcion del grado de confianza en la Fuerza Aerea Mexicana'); 59/59 labels agree in content with the questionnaire sub-item/option carrying the same number, and catalogos/bp1_*.csv value labels agree with the printed option codes for every question. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 59 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q1 2024 CSV (24022 rows) cell for cell after the .do's recodes -- 295/295 item x level (0-4) counts identical, e.g. bp1_1 1/2 = 9983/13892, bp1_3 1..4 = 5590/5028/7649/5231, bp1_6_01 0/1 = 11234/12788, bp1_9_1 1..4 = 1259/6725/3945/3089. Dropped by the .do: code 9 everywhere except bp1_6_*, and code 3 'No aplica' for bp1_2_*, bp1_5_*, bp1_7_* (e.g. bp1_2_04 escuela 3=22193, bp1_7_1 3=4231). bp1_8_*/bp1_9_* are blank in the raw file for respondents who did not identify the authority in 1.7 (NA 8928/5881/3442/2485/12184/6206 = count of bp1_7_k != 1), per the questionnaire's skip rule. Words: text_source=study_materials, the administered questionnaire wording (not the terser dictionary labels). Structure: CP1 read-aloud intro in instructions (Section I is the whole table); one section_id per question 1.1-1.9; for 1.2, 1.4-1.9 the stem is in section_prompt and the sub-item/row in item_text; 1.1 and 1.3 are single items with the stem in item_text. The 1.7, 1.8 and 1.9 stems, the 1.9 options, the 1.4/1.5/1.6 stems, the 1.1/1.3 stems and 1.4 sub-item 1 are missing or fragmentary in the PDF text layer (bold/multi-column text not extracted) and were transcribed from 150/300 dpi renders of pp.2-3 -- spot-check those; the rest are exact substrings of pdftotext output. Kept as printed: '(LUGAR)', '(CIUDAD)', '(AUTORIDAD)', 'la (al)', 'la (del)', 'la (el)' fills; '(a)'/'(as)' gender fills; trailing '?' and '...'; 1.1 and 1.3 options with their trailing '?' ('seguro?', 'mejorara?'); 'No sabe/ no responde' spacing on 1.6 code 99; 'Otro'/'Otra' write-in rows as the bare word. Normalised: line wraps joined; double spaces collapsed (1.6 opt 01 'conocidos(as)  en'; 1.9 'Algo  de confianza'). Stripped: question/option numbers, dot leaders, entry boxes, blank write-in lines, 'ESPECIFIQUE', interviewer directions (CIRCULE UN SOLO CODIGO; REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION; MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'A' Y CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES; PASA AL SIGUIENTE RENGLON; the 1.7 'No aplica solo se acepta para la Policia Preventiva Municipal' and 1.8/1.9 skip notes). The row label '[CDMX (3)]' (code 3 applies in Mexico City) is kept on bp1_7_1 only, since it qualifies 1.7's 'No aplica' code; it is omitted from bp1_8_1/bp1_9_1 which share the printed row. Options: printed labels mapped to the catalogo codes (identical in both); only levels present in the live data get rows (no row for 3 'No aplica' / 9 'No sabe / no responde', set missing by the .do). 1.6 (bp1_6_*) is a pick-up-to-three list stored as one 0/1 indicator per option: option_text 1='Si' and 0='No se declaro como opcion afirmativa' are INEGI's catalogo value labels, not questionnaire text (the questionnaire only prints the option list with codes 01-13, 99), same treatment as sibling mexico_2024_q1safety_conflicts bp2_2_*. Every level each item's respondents used has an option row. Step 3b: live items match Section I exactly (59 items: 1.1, 1.2 x12, 1.3, 1.4 x8, 1.5 x5, 1.6 x14, 1.7-1.9 x6 each). Dictionary defect: Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while the data and wording are the 2024 Q1 wave (file suffix 0324). Also the INEGI dictionary label for 1.6 ('...enterarse sobre temas relacionados con la seguridad en su ciudad') is a paraphrase; the questionnaire asks about 'la seguridad publica, el narcotrafico y/o la delincuencia en (CIUDAD)' -- shipped the questionnaire wording. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section I (questions 1.1-1.9) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, took the 0/1 labels for the question 1.6 information-source indicators (including its 'No sabe/ no responde' and 'Otra' indicators, which are shipped as items) from INEGI's data catalogue, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
